headline: As of 2026-10-29: 43,490,379 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 43,490,379 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,244,849), California (4,288,495), Florida (4,044,422).
